name: kb_context
description: Check freshness of files against the knowledge bank. Returns {fresh, stale, missing} -- fresh files can be skipped, stale/missing files must be re-read. With no confidence filter the default is confidence ["CONFIRMED","INFERRED"] plus exclude_disputed (a context-cache entry is verified by its content hash); UNVERIFIED only when listed explicitly. In a MEMBER session the default read merges the member's checkout bible (CONFIRMED) with the member's own CONFIRMED/INFERRED captures (tagged member:<caller uuid>). Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
